instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Apply font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif globally across the whole application in index.css / App.css.

2. All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, modal triggers, accordions, dropdowns) MUST have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='call-now-header-button', data-testid='callback-form-submit', data-testid='city-select-noida').
3. Header MUST NOT be completely transparent; use solid or high-opacity backdrop blur (bg-slate-900/95) to guarantee legibility.
4. Build custom SEO-optimized template structures for both location pages (/court-marriage-[city]) and service pages (/[service]-delhi).
5. Ensure the mobile sticky bar with Call Now and WhatsApp buttons is visible on viewports < 768px at all times.
6. Use Sonner toasts to give instant feedback on form submissions, callback requests, and checklist downloads.
7. Provide clear legal disclaimer components to establish genuine lawyer consultancy credibility and legal transparency.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop centered layouts. Use asymmetrical Bento cards, high contrast legal trust badges, step timelines, and rich data tables.
Do NOT use dark colors as high-frequency multi-color gradients. Keep backgrounds solid or soft neutral, using rich navy and amber for accents.
Do NOT apply universal transition: all. Use targeted micro-transitions for buttons and hover cards.
Ensure all forms have accessible field labels, error validation, and confirmation modal overlays upon submission.
Use data-testid attributes rigorously on every interactive element.
